item.title: Volkswagen precisa de cortes profundos para se manter competitiva, diz o CEO
item.description: O presidente-executivo da Volkswagen , Oliver Blume, alertou nesta sexta-feira que os problemas do setor automotivo só irão se intensificar nos próximos anos e que cortes profundos de custos são necessários para manter a principal montadora europeia competitiva.
item.dc:creator: Christina Amann
item.content:encoded: O presidente-executivo da Volkswagen , Oliver Blume, alertou nesta sexta-feira que os problemas do setor automotivo só irão se intensificar nos próximos anos e que cortes profundos de custos são necessários para manter a principal montadora europeia competitiva. Os comentários, feitos em um memorando interno da empresa visto pela Reuters, surgem em um momento em que a Volkswagen está passando pelo que é considerada a sua maior reestruturação de todos os tempos, que pode incluir desde novos cortes de 50.000 empregos até a separação de algumas divisões. Pressionada pela agressiva concorrência chinesa que se expande para a Europa, pela queda nos lucros na China e pelas pesadas tarifas de importação nos Estados Unidos, a Volkswagen enfrenta dificuldades com a queda nos lucros e o excesso de capacidade dispendioso na Europa. "A situação é mais do que crítica", disse Blume no memorando, acrescentando que, embora as margens atuais de menos de 4% sejam sólidas no ambiente atual, "elas não são de forma alguma suficientes para gerar fundos suficientes a longo prazo para novas tecnologias, novos produtos e nossas instalações". Blume, que na próxima semana visitará as fábricas da Volkswagen em risco no âmbito do atual plano de reestruturação, afirmou que os custos indiretos da montadora alemã continuam mais de 30% superiores aos de empresas comparáveis, acrescentando que essa situação precisa ser combatida para que a empresa se mantenha competitiva. O conselho de supervisão da Volkswagen tem reunião marcada para 4 de setembro para dar continuidade à discussão sobre os planos de reestruturação, segundo fontes familiarizadas com o assunto. Embora o grupo não tenha quantificado oficialmente o número de cortes adicionais de empregos, fontes disseram à Reuters que podem chegar a 50.000, o que dobraria efetivamente as demissões em massa planejadas pelo grupo. "O número frequentemente citado de cerca de 50.000 empregos em todo o mundo não é uma meta fixa", disse Blume, acrescentando que foi derivado do objetivo de custo da empresa em relação à concorrência e serviu "como um indicador da escala de ação necessária". Em julho, a Volkswagen revelou planos para reduzir drasticamente sua linha de modelos e diminuir ainda mais sua capacidade produtiva. No início deste mês, as famílias controladoras da VW aumentaram a pressão sobre todas as partes interessadas e exigiram esforços drásticos de reestruturação. Quatro fábricas da Volkswagen na Alemanha — Emden, Hannover, Zwickau e Neckarsulm — não devem atingir níveis competitivos de utilização da capacidade produtiva na década de 2030, afirmou Blume. Ele, porém, ressaltou que ainda não há nenhuma decisão sobre o fechamento de fábricas específicas. Segundo ele, houve progressos em algumas áreas, mas ainda não é suficiente, mesmo sem considerar a pressão dos novos concorrentes da China e suas fábricas na Europa. (Reportagem de Christina Amann)

item.title: Orlando City loan M Colin Guske to Real Salt Lake
item.description: Orlando City loaned 19-year-old midfielder Colin Guske to Real Salt Lake for the remainder of the 2026 season, both clubs announced Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Orlando City loaned 19-year-old midfielder Colin Guske to Real Salt Lake for the remainder of the 2026 season, both clubs announced Friday. The Lions receive $50,000 in general allocation money in the deal, while RSL holds an option to make the trade permanent at the end of the loan. "Orlando City has been my home for a long time, and I'm thankful to everyone ... who has supported me throughout my journey," he said. "I'm grateful for the opportunity to continue my development through this move and for the trust the Club has shown in helping me take this next step. My focus is on improving every day, earning opportunities on the field and helping the team however I can. I'm excited and looking forward to this next challenge." Guske has appeared in 16 matches for Orlando City across all competitions since signing a first-team contract as a homegrown player in December 2024. He has shined in the MLS NEXT Pro ranks, earning All-Star honors in 2024 and contributing one goal and four assists in 46 games (45 starts) for Orlando City B. Real Salt Lake (8-7-4, 28 points) will visit Orlando City (6-11-3, 21 points) on Saturday night. --Field Level Media

item.title: Whitecaps acquire D Sebastian Ramirez on loan
item.description: The Vancouver Whitecaps acquired defender Sebastian Ramirez from Colombia's Fortaleza on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Vancouver Whitecaps acquired defender Sebastian Ramirez from Colombia's Fortaleza on Friday. The deal for the 20-year-old Colombian center-back runs through June 2027 and includes a purchase option. "Sebastian is a young, defensively minded player who has emerged as a key contributor for Fortaleza," Whitecaps sporting director Axel Schuster said. "He brings a strong balance of aggression and awareness to defensive situations, while also offering versatility across multiple positions. We're excited to welcome Sebastian to the group and look forward to supporting his continued development." Ramirez recorded three goals in 46 appearances (26 starts) across all competitions with Fortaleza. "I'm very excited to have arrived at Whitecaps FC, it is a great opportunity for me to grow and I'm looking forward to giving my best to help the team," he said. "I know I am joining a club that strives to win, so I will work hard to help this team win titles and bring joy to the fans in this city." --Field Level Media

item.title: Integrantes da Otan discutem opções para Estreito de Ormuz sem envolvimento da aliança
item.description: O comandante-chefe da Otan convocou uma videoconferência nesta semana para facilitar possíveis contribuições em apoio à liberdade de navegação no Estreito de Ormuz, informou seu porta-voz à Reuters, acrescentando que não se trata de uma missão da Otan.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O comandante-chefe da Otan convocou uma videoconferência nesta semana para facilitar possíveis contribuições em apoio à liberdade de navegação no Estreito de Ormuz, informou seu porta-voz à Reuters, acrescentando que não se trata de uma missão da Otan. “O Quartel-General Supremo das Potências Aliadas na Europa (Shape) organizou uma reunião com os aliados interessados, no nível de chefes de defesa, na quarta-feira, 19 de agosto de 26, a fim de facilitar suas possíveis contribuições para apoiar a liberdade de navegação no Estreito de Ormuz”, disse nesta sexta-feira um porta-voz do comandante-chefe da aliança, o general da Força Aérea dos EUA Alexus Grynkewich. “Para deixar claro, esta não é uma missão da Otan. Mas, dada a capacidade única da Otan de reunir os aliados e compreender os recursos que eles podem mobilizar, faz sentido que a Otan atue como facilitadora dessa forma”, acrescentou o porta-voz. Os aliados da Otan têm procurado evitar o envolvimento direto no conflito com o Irã, concentrando-se, em vez disso, em planos fora da aliança para reabrir o estreito, que, antes de fevereiro, transportava cerca de um quinto de todo o petróleo comercializado. A França e o Reino Unido têm liderado os esforços para formar uma coalizão de cerca de uma dúzia de países a fim de garantir a passagem segura pelo estreito assim que as tensões diminuírem ou o conflito for resolvido, embora qualquer acordo de longo prazo exija, em última instância, a aquiescência iraniana.

item.title: Ukraine-Au moins 14 morts dans une frappe russe sur un centre commercial
item.description: Au moins quatorze personnes ont été tuées dans une attaque russe de drones visant un centre commercial, qui a également blessé plus de 120 personnes dans la ville ukrainienne de Kryvyi Rih, ont annoncé vendredi les autorités locales.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Au moins quatorze personnes ont été tuées dans une attaque russe de drones visant un centre commercial, qui a également blessé plus de 120 personnes dans la ville ukrainienne de Kryvyi Rih, ont annoncé vendredi les autorités locales. L'attaque, qui s'est déroulée en plein jour dans la ville natale du président ukrainien Volodimir Zelensky, a blessé 22 enfants, a rapporté le gouverneur régional Oleksandr Hanzha sur Telegram. "Il y a 29 personnes dans un état sérieux, dont un enfant", a-t-il dit, accompagnant sa publication d'un cliché montrant de la fumée s'échappant d'un bâtiment. Le président ukrainien a qualifié l'attaque "d'absolument cynique et ignoble", ajoutant qu'un deuxième drone russe avait frappé le centre commercial une demi-heure après la première salve, ce qu'il a présenté comme la volonté de la part de Moscou de s'en prendre aux services de secours. "Les attaques de ce genre ne sont rien de moins que des actes terroristes", a déclaré Volodimir Zelensky sur Telegram. Moscou a intensifié ses attaques sur l'Ukraine. Jeudi, 17 personnes ont trouvé la mort dans une attaque de missiles balistiques russes sur Kyiv. L'Ukraine cible de son côté les installations pétrolières et les infrastructures logistiques russes pour empêcher la Russie de mener sa guerre.

item.title: Lula, Trump discuss tariffs in phone call, Brazil says
item.description: Brazil's President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and U.S. President Donald Trump spoke by phone on Friday and discussed tariffs Washington recently imposed on Brazilian goods, according to a statement from Brazil's government.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Brazil's President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and U.S. President Donald Trump spoke by phone on Friday and discussed tariffs Washington recently imposed on Brazilian goods, according to a statement from Brazil's government. During the call, Lula reiterated that negotiations are the best way to resolve the dispute, while Trump suggested that officials from both countries meet as soon as possible, the statement said. The U.S. government announced [USN:FWN43H1K7 TEXT:"25% tariffs"] last month on some Brazilian goods, alleging unfair trade practices, as well as [USN:S0N42I03Z TEXT:"12.5% tariffs"] on goods from dozens of nations, including Brazil, linked to allegations of lax enforcement of forced labor bans. Lula said in the statement that the tariffs would harm both economies and that the allegations cited by Washington to justify the measures, including concerns over deforestation, intellectual property, corruption, Brazil's Pix instant payment system, ethanol and imports allegedly tied to forced labor, were unfounded. [USN:L6N44A1G3 TEXT:"Earlier this month"], Brazil started a process seeking further consultations with U.S. trade authorities, a move that could lead to measures against Washington. Lula reiterated in the call Brazil's interest in cooperating with the U.S. to combat organized crime, but said criminal gangs operating in Brazil should not be equated with terrorist organizations, the label [USN:L1N4251B8 TEXT:"Washington applied"] to two of them in May.

item.title: Wizards acquire G Tre Mann as part of 5-team trade
item.description: The Washington Wizards acquired guard Tre Mann from the Charlotte Hornets as part of a five-team trade.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Washington Wizards acquired guard Tre Mann from the Charlotte Hornets as part of a five-team trade. The Wizards also received a 2027 second-round pick from the Los Angeles Clippers as part of the deal on Thursday. Washington, in turn, sent Cam Whitmore to the Cleveland Cavaliers and fellow forward Juju Reese to the Denver Nuggets. Mann, 25, averaged 5.5 points, 1.7 rebounds and 1.6 assists in 53 games (one start) last season with Charlotte. He has contributed 8.5 points, 2.6 boards and 2.1 assists in 234 career games (60 starts) with the Oklahoma City Thunder and Hornets. Whitmore, 22, averaged 9.2 points and 2.8 rebounds in 21 games off the bench last season with the Wizards. He has averaged 10.5 points and 3.3 boards in 119 games (five starts) with the Houston Rockets and Wizards. Reese, 23, made his NBA debut last season and contributed 11.8 points and 10.5 rebounds in 13 games (10 starts) for Washington. --Field Level Media

item.title: US plans $725 million payment towards its large UN debt
item.description: The Trump administration has started the process to transfer $725 million to the United Nations, a congressional notification seen by Reuters showed, a move aid experts said was a welcome step towards paying billions in dues owed.
item.dc:creator: Humeyra Pamuk, Emma Farge
item.content:encoded: The Trump administration has started the process to transfer $725 million to the United Nations, a congressional notification seen by Reuters showed, a move aid experts said was a welcome step towards paying billions in dues owed. There was no immediate response from Washington to questions about the reasons for the payment from an administration which has slashed funding to many U.N. agencies and [USN:L6N3VA0KJ TEXT:"blasted"] the global body for not living up to its potential. The money - mentioned in an August 4 State Department notification letter to Congress that has not been reported - is set to go through before an expected speech by U.S. President Donald Trump to the U.N. General Assembly in New York next month. 'IT KEEPS THE SHIP AFLOAT A LITTLE LONGER' U.N. Secretary-General Antonio Guterres said this year that the U.N. faced "[USN:L6N3YV0SW TEXT:"imminent financial collapse"]" due to unpaid contributions from member states, and the global body has brought in large budget cuts. The $725 million would be less than 20% of the more than $4 billion that the U.N. said in May it was owed by the United States — though Washington has said that total figure [USN:L1N3ZF0SP TEXT:"is much lower"] and that it has made some payments. Eugene Chen, a former U.N. official, told Reuters such a transfer would help pay U.N. salaries for a period, but might not cover them all. "It keeps the ship afloat a little longer," he said. "If the U.S. does not make further payments it will likely lose its voting rights in January," he added. Under article 19 of the U.N. Charter, a member state loses its voting rights in the General Assembly if its arrears exceed two years in annual fees, although grace periods are possible. A significant transfer now could avert the need for immediate spending cuts, Ronny Patz, an expert in U.N. finance with German think tank IDOS, said. "If they pay a big chunk, the U.N. still runs on zero reserves but it gets through the year," Patz added. “If they don’t pay, the U.N. might really be in trouble for the last two or three months of the year in terms of paying salaries and keeping the doors open.” The U.S. is the biggest contributor to the U.N. budget, but under the Trump administration it has refused to make mandatory payments to regular and peacekeeping budgets, and has slashed voluntary funding to U.N. agencies with their own budgets. Washington [USN:L1N3Y8138 TEXT:"has also withdrawn from"] dozens of U.N. and other international agencies. The U.N. had been counting on collecting around 90% of dues from its 193 members for this year's budget, its Controller Chandramouli Ramanathan said last month. As of August 18, some 129 members had paid in full, a U.N. document showed. China, the number 2 contributor after Washington, was also absent from the list. The State Department said in its August 4 letter it was obligating a total of $725 million for the U.N.'s regular budget. The U.S. State Department and the U.S. diplomatic mission to the United Nations did not immediately respond to requests for comment by email on Friday. In May, the U.N. said the more than $4 billion owed to it by Washington included $2.04 billion for the regular budget, $2.2 billion for current and past peacekeeping missions, and $44 million for U.N. tribunals. Washington has not transferred around $153.4 million in what it calls "policy-based withholdings". That included $10.6 million meant for the Human Rights Council — which Washington disengaged from last year alleging an anti-Israel bias — and funds for the [USN:L1N3XF0SR TEXT:"U.N. Palestinian Refugee Agency"]. The 80-year-old institution has been undergoing a decisive reform and cost-cutting exercise known as "UN80" amid its financial crisis. It has already cut its 2026 budget by 9.2% and transferred over 2,000 jobs out of expensive cities like[USN:L1N41D1E4 TEXT:" Geneva"] and New York to lower-cost hubs.

item.title: Root disappointed over Headingley missing out on Ashes test
item.description: England captain Joe Root expressed his disappointment on Friday that Headingley will not stage an Ashes test next year after leading his country to a crushing victory over Pakistan by an innings and 103 runs at his home ground.
item.dc:creator: Neil Squires
item.content:encoded: England captain Joe Root expressed his disappointment on Friday that Headingley will not stage an Ashes test next year after leading his country to a crushing [USN:L6N44I0T1 TEXT:"victory over Pakistan"] by an innings and 103 runs at his home ground. England have won their last seven tests in Leeds, including wins over Australia on their last two visits, and Root feels the ECB have missed a trick in choosing to overlook the ground. Lord’s, The Oval, Edgbaston, Trent Bridge and Southampton will stage Ashes tests next summer with England not down to play another men’s test at Headingley until 2029. “I’d love to play as many games as possible here. I think it’s a great test match venue,” said Root. “It’s a surface that provides brilliant test cricket and one that we’ve had quite a lot of success at recently, so it’s a shame that we don’t get to play here next year but I’m sure we’ll see many, many more brilliant test matches here. “As a player it would be nice to have a choice. It’s a ground that we generally do well at and we love playing here. As a Yorkshireman I sort of have to say that from birth.” Root was delighted with the manner of the victory over Pakistan in his first game since assuming the permanent captaincy role again. “It couldn’t have really gone better for us,” he said. “I’m just really pleased with our performance and the way we dealt with things out there.” Pakistan’s defeat was their ninth in their last 10 away matches. “We’re not playing well for sure when it comes to away series. We haven’t done well anywhere in the world and this is concerning,” said Pakistan stand-in captain Salman Ali Agha. “One thing I can say is we are trying and hopefully in the second game we can change that. We'll come back stronger."

item.title: GRANOS El maíz cotiza estable tras alcanzar su máximo en 18 meses
item.description: Los futuros del maíz en Chicago tenían un desempeño irregular el viernes, tras alcanzar en la sesión anterior un máximo en 18 meses, mientras los operadores asimilaban resultados decepcionantes de una gira de inspección de cultivos que suscitó dudas sobre el rendimiento de la cosecha estadounidense.
item.dc:creator: Heather Schlitz
item.content:encoded: Los futuros del maíz en Chicago tenían un desempeño irregular el viernes, tras alcanzar en la sesión anterior un máximo en 18 meses, mientras los operadores asimilaban resultados decepcionantes de una gira de inspección de cultivos que suscitó dudas sobre el rendimiento de la cosecha estadounidense. La soja también experimentaba altibajos el viernes, tras el repunte de principios de esta semana, debido a los resultados dispares de la visita de campo de Pro Farmer y a la racha continua de ventas de exportación a China. El trigo se mantenía estable mientras los operadores esperaban señales de que las interrupciones en las exportaciones de Rusia y Ucrania provocadas por la guerra lleven a los importadores a comprar en otros orígenes. El contrato de maíz más activo en la Bolsa de Chicago subía 3,25 centavos, a 5,0675 dólares por bushel, a las 1600 GMT, tras haber alcanzado el jueves su máximo desde febrero de 2025. La soja bajaba 0,25 centavos, a 12,3625 dólares por bushel. "Estamos a la espera de los resultados de la gira de inspección de cultivos; creo que nos enfrentamos a un rendimiento del maíz inferior al previsto por el Departamento de Agricultura de Estados Unidos (USDA)", dijo Dan Smith, director de Top Third Ag Marketing. El mercado ha seguido de cerca los informes de la gira de campo de Pro Farmer porque el USDA ya había recortado la semana pasada sus previsiones de rendimiento para el maíz y la soja. Los inspectores encontraron el jueves, último día de la gira de cuatro días, cosechas excelentes en las zonas orientales de Iowa y Minnesota, pero nada que cuestione las expectativas de que la cosecha de maíz de este año en Estados Unidos no alcanzará el récord del año pasado. Unos rendimientos más bajos podrían reducir la oferta estadounidense en un momento de fuerte demanda de maíz y soja. La soja, en particular, se ha visto respaldada por la fuerte alza de los márgenes de molienda y el ritmo constante de compras por parte de China. El trigo cedía 2,5 centavos, a 6,975 dólares por bushel. Los importadores mundiales de trigo se preparan para una mayor escasez de oferta, ya que los ataques recíprocos de Rusia y Ucrania contra puertos y buques en las últimas semanas han provocado el cierre de terminales de cereales y han obligado a los transportistas a retrasar o cancelar la carga durante la temporada alta de exportación.

item.title: Ações sobem, mas preocupações com inflação levam a queda semanal
item.description: As ações europeias subiram nesta sexta-feira com os investidores focados em sinais de resiliência econômica, mas o índice de referência encerrou a semana em baixa com os preços elevados do petróleo e os rendimentos dos Treasuries mantendo vivas as preocupações com a inflação.
item.dc:creator: Tharuniyaa Lakshmi, Utkarsh Hathi
item.content:encoded: As ações europeias subiram nesta sexta-feira com os investidores focados em sinais de resiliência econômica, mas o índice de referência encerrou a semana em baixa com os preços elevados do petróleo e os rendimentos dos Treasuries mantendo vivas as preocupações com a inflação. O índice pan-europeu STOXX 600 (.STOXX) fechou com alta de 0,59%, a 654,18 pontos, mas registrando perdas pela segunda semana consecutiva. Um salto nos rendimentos dos títulos de longo prazo dos Estados Unidos nesta semana inquietou os investidores globais e prejudicou o apetite por risco, antes que o Tesouro dos EUA anunciasse medidas para aumentar o suporte à liquidez, o que muitos consideraram uma solução temporária. No entanto, uma temporada de balanços sólida tem sustentado o apetite por risco na Europa, com a economia da região mostrando sinais de resiliência apesar do conflito no Oriente Médio devido à sua exposição limitada ao comércio de IA e a uma perspectiva mais clara da política monetária. A atividade empresarial da zona do euro está crescendo no ritmo mais acelerado deste ano graças a novos pedidos no setor manufatureiro e à retomada do crescimento das exportações, segundo dados divulgados na sexta-feira. O índice PMI Composto S&P Global para a zona do euro atingiu neste mês o maior nível desde novembro. Ainda assim, os investidores continuam cautelosos em tirar conclusão demais os dados recentes, dada a incerteza em relação à inflação. Entre os setores, as ações de luxo (.STXLUXP) subiram 1,4%, recuperando-se da queda na sessão anterior, enquanto os recursos básicos (.SXPP) lideraram os ganhos setoriais, subindo 2,5%, uma vez que o dólar mais fraco impulsionou os preços do ouro. Em LONDRES, o índice Financial Times (.FTSE) avançou 0,64%, a 10.816,56 pontos. Em FRANKFURT, o índice DAX (.GDAXI) subiu 0,59%, a 26.136,56 pontos. Em PARIS, o índice CAC-40 (.FCHI) ganhou 0,37%, a 8.484,43 pontos. Em MILÃO, o índice Ftse/Mib (.FTMIB) ficou estável, a 52.668,04 pontos. Em MADRI, o índice Ibex-35 (.IBEX) registrou alta de 0,76%, a 19.961,50 pontos. Em LISBOA, o índice PSI20 (.PSI20) valorizou-se 0,78%, a 9.354,78 pontos.

item.title: Norris still believes he can retain his F1 title
item.description: Lando Norris still believes he has a chance of successfully defending his Formula One title, even though he says he is not currently in the championship chase.
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: Lando Norris still believes he has a chance of successfully defending his Formula One title, even though he says he is not currently in the championship chase. The McLaren driver, who [USN:L6N44I0VZ TEXT:"qualified on the front row"] for Saturday's Dutch Grand Prix sprint race, starts the second half of the season in fifth position overall and a mighty 91 points behind Mercedes' championship leader Kimi Antonelli. With a maximum 12 rounds to go, and possibly only 11 if the last two Middle Eastern races have to be cancelled and replaced by one final European grand prix, closing the gap and overtaking the Italian looks a tall order. It is still mathematically possible, however, and Red Bull's four-times champion Max Verstappen came back from 104 points behind Norris' teammate Oscar Piastri at the end of August last season to finish just two points behind Norris. NOT STRESSED AT ALL "This year I don't feel stressed at all. I feel very relaxed," Norris told reporters before the track action started at Zandvoort. "For two reasons: One because of what I achieved last year and two because I'm not in the fight." Asked whether he really believed the latter part of that statement, given every racing driver's instinct to battle and hope even against the odds, Norris clarified his position. "Of course I'm in the fight. If you want to compare it to Max last season you can do. But I don't mean it that way. I'm just not first, second (place) in the championship. "Max didn't think he was in the fight at this point last season. So it's more just the saying of that. "I still believe it's possible ... there's still a chance. And if there's a chance, then I want to fight for it." Norris qualified second for the grand prix at Zandvoort last year, when the sprint format was not used, but retired from the race and was left 34 points behind Piastri. That remains the Australian's most recent win in Formula One, with Norris then reeling him in over the rest of the campaign. Norris, who celebrated McLaren's [USN:L6N43S048 TEXT:"first win of the season"] in Hungary last month, said at no point this year had he felt his situation was impossible, even if hope was thin on the ground. "There's been not many reasons to believe why it is possible until Budapest," he said. "So obviously now it's a more genuine question."

item.title: POINT MARCHÉS L'Europe finit dans le vert, l'obligataire et la géopolitique restent un frein
item.description: Les Bourses européennes ont terminé en hausse vendredi, retrouvant un peu de couleur après une série de séances tendues en raison de la hausse mondiale du coût de la dette publique et de l'absence de progrès diplomatiques au Moyen-Orient.
item.dc:creator: Diana Mandia
item.content:encoded: Les Bourses européennes ont terminé en hausse vendredi, retrouvant un peu de couleur après une série de séances tendues en raison de la hausse mondiale du coût de la dette publique et de l'absence de progrès diplomatiques au Moyen-Orient. À Paris, le CAC 40 (.FCHI) a gagné 0,37% à 8.484,43 points. À Francfort, le Dax (.GDAXI) a pris 0,56% et à Londres, le FTSE 100 (.FTSE) a progressé de 0,64%. L'indice EuroStoxx 50 (.STOXX50E) a fini sur un gain de 0,56%, le FTSEurofirst 300 (.FTEU3) de 0,53% et le Stoxx 600 (.STOXX) de 0,51%. Sur la semaine, le Stoxx 600 abandonne en revanche 0,64% et le CAC 40 1,76%. Les tensions sur les marchés obligataires mondiaux ne montrent guère de signes d'apaisement, les rendements des bons du Trésor américain repartant à la hausse malgré un bref répit induit par l'annonce des États-Unis de son intention d'acheter davantage de dette à long terme. Le déficit budgétaire de la première économie mondiale dépasse les 6% du produit intérieur brut (PIB), les paiements d'intérêts s'élevant à eux seuls à 1.200 milliards de dollars cette année, tandis que la dette vient de franchir la barre des [USN:L6N44G191 TEXT:"40.000 milliards"] de dollars. Cet endettement sans précédent touche également d'autres grandes économies mondiales, notamment l'Allemagne et la France, où les rendements de leurs obligations à long terme respectives ont également atteint cette semaine des sommets inégalés depuis bien plus d'une décennie. Les rendements des OAT françaises à 10 ans ont augmenté à un rythme plus rapide que leurs pairs allemandes, portant le "spread" à plus de 87 points de base ce vendredi en séance, un écart qui pourrait encore se creuser à mesure que le débat budgétaire s'intensifie à la rentrée. Même si ce n'est pas le seul facteur, les anticipations d'inflation constituent un élément essentiel des turbulences sur le marché obligataire, l'impasse diplomatique dans le Golfe installant les cours du pétrole au-delà des 90 dollars le baril, avec la navigation dans le détroit d'Ormuz [USN:L6N44I06E TEXT:"fortement perturbée"]. Selon le secrétaire américain au Trésor, Scott Bessent, les Etats-Unis vont imposer "les sanctions les plus sévères de l'histoire" contre l'Iran, qui a répondu vendredi que sa riposte à toute nouvelle menace américaine serait "dévastatrice". "Une recrudescence des incidents maritimes et des mesures de rétorsion contre les sanctions économiques pourraient aggraver la situation actuelle, alors que le trafic dans le détroit d'Ormuz reste bien en deçà des niveaux habituels", a averti Crispus Nyaga, analyste chez Empire FX. Les investisseurs ont par ailleurs devant eux une semaine très chargée, avec la publication du rapport sur l'inflation PCE aux États-Unis et le symposium de Jackson Hole à l'ordre du jour des responsables de la politique monétaire. Un autre temps fort des prochains jours sera la publication des résultats du fabricant de puces d'IA Nvidia (NVDA.O) , prévue mercredi. VALEURS Les ressources de base (.SXPP) se sont distinguées vendredi parmi les secteur du Stoxx 600, progressant de 2,57% grâce à la hausse des cours de l'or, dans un contexte de faiblesse du dollar américain. Les producteurs d'acier ont également connu une séance favorable, ArcelorMittal terminant sur un gain de 2,3%. A WALL STREET Les principaux indices américains sont dans le vert après les fortes baisses enregistrées la veille sur fond de tensions dans le marché de la dette souveraine. A l'heure de la clôture en Europe, le Dow Jones (.DJI) gagne 0,76%, le Standard & Poor's 500 (.SPX) 0,53% et le Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) 0,49%. Aux valeurs, la plateforme destinée aux investisseurs particuliers Robinhood (HOOD.O) prend plus de 12% et l'opérateur de crypto-bourses Coinbase Global (COIN.O) 9%, soutenus par l'appréciation du bitcoin , qui a atteint vendredi son plus haut niveau depuis mai. LES INDICATEURS DU JOUR La séance a été riche en indicateurs, notamment en Europe. L'activité du secteur privé dans la zone euro [USN:ZRN00EEK5 TEXT:"a enregistré"] en août sa plus forte progression depuis novembre, soutenue par une hausse des nouvelles commandes, notamment dans le secteur manufacturier, et par un retour à la croissance des exportations, montre l'enquête préliminaire sur les directeurs d'achat (PMI). La confiance des consommateurs du bloc s'est pour sa part légèrement améliorée depuis le début du mois, selon les [USN:L8N44I0SK TEXT:"résultats préliminaires"] de l'enquête mensuelle de la Commission européenne. En France, en revanche, l'activité [USN:ZRN00EEJR TEXT:"s'est contractée"] plus fortement que prévu, les récentes vagues de chaleur ayant pesé sur le secteur prédominant des services. Au Royaume-Uni, le secteur des services, moteur de l'économie du pays, a connu une reprise inattendue en août, qui vient s'ajouter aux signes de résilience observés outre-Manche malgré le conflit au Moyen-Orient. CHANGES Le dollar réduit ses pertes (-0,02%) face à un panier de devises de référence (.DXY) , tout en restant proche de son plus bas niveau depuis trois mois face à l'euro, les investisseurs se demandant si les efforts déployés par le Trésor américain pour apaiser les marchés obligataires ne risquaient pas de saper la confiance dans la devise. L'euro cède 0,03 à 1,1674 dollar . Le [USN:L6N44I0SD TEXT:"bitcoin"] grimpe de plus de 6% à 77.539 dollars, porté par la décision du Trésor américain de doubler le montant de ses rachats d'obligations et alors que le président américain a exhorté le Congrès à adopter un projet de loi favorable aux les cryptomonnaies. TAUX Les rendements des obligations américaine progressent vendredi, l'effet des annonces du Trésor s'estompant, tandis qu'une série de données publiées vendredi montrent une forte expansion du secteur des services aux États-Unis ce mois-ci. Le rendement des Treasuries à dix ans avance de 3,8 points de base à 4,7359%, tandis que celui du titre à deux ans prend 5,5 points de base à 4,2401%. Dans la zone euro, les rendements ont fini sur la séance sur une note plus stable, celui du Bund allemand à dix ans progressant à peine pour s'établir à 3,2561%. Celui de l'obligation à deux ans a fini à 2,8378%. En France, le rendement de l'OAT à dix ans a pris 1,4 points de base à 4,1311%. Celui du titre à 30 ans a terminé sur un gain d'environ 2 points de base, à 4,91%. PÉTROLE L'incertitude liée au conflit au Moyen-Orient continue d'affecter les marchés de l'énergie. Le Brent avance de 0,28% à 94,04 dollars le baril, s'orientant à un gain hebdomadaire de plus de 6%, tandis que le brut léger américain (West Texas Intermediate, WTI) cède 0,22% à 86,64 dollars. item.title: NATO members discuss Strait of Hormuz options without alliance involvement
item.description: NATO's top commander convened a videoconference earlier this week to facilitate possible contributions to support freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz, his spokesperson told Reuters, adding that this is not a NATO mission.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: NATO's top commander convened a videoconference earlier this week to facilitate possible contributions to support freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz, his spokesperson told Reuters, adding that this is not a NATO mission. “Supreme Headquarters Allied Powers Europe hosted a meeting of interested Allies at the chief of defence level on Wednesday, 19 Aug 26, in order to facilitate their possible contributions to support freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz," a spokesperson for the alliance's top commander U.S. Air Force General Alexus Grynkewich said on Friday. "To be clear, this is not a NATO mission. But given NATO’s unique strengths in its ability to bring together Allies and understand the capabilities they bring to bear, it makes sense for NATO to facilitate in this way," the spokesperson added. NATO allies have sought to avoid direct involvement in the Iran conflict, instead focusing on plans outside the alliance to reopen the strait, which before February carried about a fifth of all traded oil. France and Britain have led efforts to build a coalition among roughly a dozen countries to guarantee safe passage through the strait once tensions ease or the conflict is resolved, though any long-term arrangement would ultimately require Iranian acquiescence.

item.title: Three scientists beat J&J's defamation suit over talc research
item.description: A U.S. judge in Virginia has ruled that three researchers did not defame Johnson & Johnson by publishing research linking cosmetic talcum powder products to mesothelioma, a rare form of cancer.
item.dc:creator: Dietrich Knauth
item.content:encoded: A U.S. judge in Virginia has ruled that three researchers did not defame Johnson & Johnson by publishing research linking cosmetic talcum powder products to mesothelioma, a rare form of cancer. J&J sued Theresa Emory, John Maddox and Richard Kradin, alleging that they defamed the company in a 2020 scientific article. The article said it reviewed 75 patients who had mesothelioma and had no link to asbestos other than exposure to cosmetic talc products like baby powder. U.S. District Judge Jamar Walker on Wednesday ruled in favor of the scientists, finding no evidence of "malice" in their article. The litigation revealed some "mistakes" in the data, but nothing that was obvious or ignored at the time of the study, according to the ruling. J&J said it would appeal, seeking a trial on its claims that the scientists made false statements about cosmetic talc and asbestos exposure. The three defendants are doctors who maintain pathology practices, and who have testified as plaintiffs' experts in asbestos litigation. The scientists' attorney, Liz Lockwood, said that the ruling vindicates her clients and strongly affirms the importance of protecting scientific speech. J&J has been facing a [USN:L2N3QF0U4 TEXT:"deluge of litigation"] over its talc products, and it [USN:L1N38W2IH TEXT:"sued the scientists"] before agreeing to settle those cases for at [USN:FWN43T12P TEXT:"least $5.5 billion."] The company showed that eight of the 75 patients in the 2020 study had been included in a 2019 study by another researcher, even though the 2020 study claimed to have an entirely new set of patients. J&J has also sued the scientist who published the 2019 paper. The researchers were comparing anonymized data sets and information provided by lawyers, making it sometimes difficult to detect duplicates, the ruling said.

item.title: Shadow banks enter a newly uncertain era
item.description: Loans to private credit funds and other lightly regulated lenders grew just 3% in the second quarter, from 9% a year prior. Reasons for caution abound. Yet these upstarts are now crucial sources of corporate financing, raising the stakes of a slowdown if their funding dries up.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Gandel
item.content:encoded: U.S. banks are taking a half-step back from the shadows. Loans from their domestic branches to non-depository financial institutions — a motley assortment of private credit and equity funds, mortgage brokers and financial technology upstarts — rose just 3% between the first and second quarters, according to preliminary government data aggregated by KBRA Financial Intelligence. That’s down from a 9% pace a year ago and the slowest growth in at least two years. As so-called shadow banks become increasingly crucial sources of corporate lending, a slowdown in their funding grows more worrying. Caution from depository banks is understandable. Private credit's problems, from heavy exposure to AI-vulnerable software companies to allegations of fraud in cases like auto supplier First Brands , have badly wrong-footed a vast complex of funds. JPMorgan boss Jamie Dimon memorably warned of further “ cockroaches ” hiding among lending markets. These shadow lenders have been the fastest-growing part of the financial system over the past decade and a half. In an effort to make traditional banks safer after the 2008 financial crisis, regulators effectively pushed them away from direct, on-balance-sheet lending to riskier borrowers. Consumers with low credit scores and highly leveraged companies increasingly turned to fintechs and private credit firms, respectively. Investors seeking higher returns amid years of rock-bottom interest rates were happy to provide the capital. Since the pandemic, a bit more than one of every two dollars lent to non-financial businesses in America has come from a nonbank, according to data from the Federal Reserve. Much of this growth has been financed by traditional banks. Loans to non-depository financial institutions expanded by 26% annually since 2012, researchers at the St. Louis Fed reckon . Signs of a pullback now abound. For instance, JPMorgan (JPM.N) began restricting credit lines it had extended to private credit funds earlier this year, Reuters [USN:L4N400101 TEXT:"reported"] in March. Combined loans outstanding to the industry from the six largest U.S. banks rose just 1.5% in the second quarter from the prior three months. Lending to fintechs and other consumer lenders fell 1.5%. Economic growth depends on the free flow of credit. The Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation’s upcoming official release of quarterly data will likely show healthy growth across 18 of the 19 lending segments it follows. The problem is that those figures, focused as they are on depository lenders, will partly miss what has become one of the most important sources of financing. What shows up thus far seems to indicate a shadowy retreat. Follow Stephen Gandel on LinkedIn and X . The Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation is set to release quarterly official data on lending by the United States' over 4,000 banks, both public and non-public, on August 25. According to preliminary data, bank loans to non-depository financial institutions grew just 3% in the second quarter versus the first three months of the year. CONTEXT-NEWS

item.title: Turquía pedirá a Interpol una orden de detención contra Netanyahu en el caso de la flotilla de Gaza
item.description: Turquía anunció el viernes que solicitaría una alerta roja de Interpol para la detención del primer ministro israelí, Benjamin Netanyahu, en el marco de una causa penal nacional relacionada con un ataque contra activistas que intentaban entregar ayuda humanitaria a Gaza.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Turquía anunció el viernes que solicitaría una alerta roja de Interpol para la detención del primer ministro israelí, Benjamin Netanyahu, en el marco de una causa penal nacional relacionada con un ataque contra activistas que intentaban entregar ayuda humanitaria a Gaza. Turquía, miembro de la OTAN, ha sido uno de los críticos más feroces del asalto de Israel a Gaza y ya había emitido anteriormente órdenes de detención nacionales contra Netanyahu por la guerra en esa zona. Ankara ha pedido en repetidas ocasiones que se adopten medidas internacionales ante Israel por lo que califica de violaciones de los derechos humanos y del derecho internacional. Israel niega las acusaciones. En mayo, las fuerzas israelíes abrieron fuego contra al menos dos embarcaciones de la Flotilla Global Sumud que navegaban hacia Gaza para llevar ayuda al enclave, después de que misiones anteriores fueron interceptadas por Israel en aguas internacionales. En una publicación en X, el ministro de Justicia turco, Akin Gurlek, dijo que se habían dictado órdenes de detención contra Netanyahu y otro sospechoso por cargos que incluían genocidio, crímenes contra la humanidad y tortura, en el marco de un proceso frente a 35 personas por la interceptación israelí en aguas internacionales. "En consonancia con las órdenes de detención dictadas contra Benjamin Netanyahu (...) nuestro Ministerio de Justicia ha solicitado al Ministerio del Interior que emita notificaciones rojas (de la Interpol) contra ellos para que puedan ser buscados a nivel internacional", dijo Gurlek. Turquía usará todos los mecanismos legales a su alcance para garantizar que Israel rinda cuentas por sus crímenes en Gaza, añadió. Una notificación roja es una solicitud dirigida a las fuerzas policiales de todo el mundo para localizar y detener provisionalmente a una persona en espera de su extradición. La Interpol examina las solicitudes presentadas por los Estados miembros antes de decidir si emite alertas rojas. ISRAEL CALIFICA LA MEDIDA DE "PATÉTICA" Al ser preguntada sobre la declaración de Gurlek, la oficina de Netanyahu dijo: "El patético intento de (el presidente turco, Tayyip) Erdogan de intimidar a los líderes y soldados de Israel, la única verdadera democracia de Oriente Medio, no llevará a ninguna parte". Turquía e Israel también intercambiaron críticas esta semana en relación con Siria, donde Israel llevó a cabo ataques aéreos contra una base aérea en la que, según dijo, podrían desplegarse soldados turcos, lo que provocó la condena de Ankara y las críticas de Estados Unidos. Siria ha dicho que no había planes de desplegar soldados turcos en la base. La influencia de Turquía en Siria, como aliada del presidente sirio Ahmed al-Sharaa, ha despertado la alarma israelí desde que Sharaa derrocó al veterano líder Bashar al-Asad en 2024. Ankara ha afirmado que la retórica israelí contra Turquía y sus acciones en Siria se ven avivadas por la proximidad de las elecciones parlamentarias que se celebrarán en Israel en octubre.

item.title: Raiders not quite ready to name starting quarterback
item.description: Las Vegas Raiders coach Klint Kubiak is in no rush to name a starting quarterback and says the battle between rookie Fernando Mendoza and veteran Kirk Cousins will continue.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las Vegas Raiders coach Klint Kubiak is in no rush to name a starting quarterback and says the battle between rookie Fernando Mendoza and veteran Kirk Cousins will continue. "We got another week. I don't want anyone to be comfortable in their job," Kubiak said after Thursday's preseason road win against the Houston Texans. "It should always be that way for all positions. So, let's keep going." Mendoza, the Heisman Trophy winner and No. 1 overall draft pick, started the 22-20 victory and threw an 80-yard pick-six in the first quarter. He played the first half and completed 8 of 15 passes for 86 yards. "Coach Kubiak outlined for the team what the plan was going to be with the starters, essentially for Weeks 1, 2 and 3 of the preseason, [and] to keep it internally," Mendoza said. "That was something I knew going into the game was going to be a great experience as a first start in the NFL preseason, which is always the next step." Cousins, who turned 38 on Wednesday, did not take any snaps against the Texans after playing just one drive in the preseason opener vs. Arizona on Aug. 13. Cousins was 5-of-6 passing for 50 yards and a touchdown against the Cardinals, while the 22-year-old Mendoza threw for 97 yards and a TD on 10-of-16 passing. Las Vegas concludes preseason action at home against the San Francisco 49ers next Thursday and opens the regular season against the visiting Miami Dolphins on Sept. 13. --Field Level Media

item.title: Mexican governor accused by US of cartel ties returns to office
item.description: The governor of Mexico's Sinaloa state, Ruben Rocha, returned to office on Friday after taking leave for more than three months following U.S. drug trafficking charges alleging ties to the Sinaloa Cartel, a move likely to deepen strains between Mexico and the United States.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The governor of Mexico's Sinaloa state, Ruben Rocha, returned to office on Friday after taking leave for more than three months following U.S. drug trafficking charges alleging ties to the Sinaloa Cartel, a move likely to deepen strains between Mexico and the United States. Rocha, 77, a member of Mexico's ruling Morena party, said he was resuming his duties after Mexican authorities found no evidence to support the accusations against him. In a statement posted on X, Rocha denied wrongdoing and cast the U.S. case as a politically motivated attack on Mexico's sovereignty and on the leftist movement led by President Claudia Sheinbaum. The U.S. State Department did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Mexico has so far declined to act on U.S. efforts to bring Rocha into custody, saying Washington has not provided sufficient evidence to justify domestic arrest warrants or extradition. For U.S. officials, the April indictment marked a rare expansion of anti-cartel action beyond drug bosses to include a sitting senior Mexican politician. U.S. prosecutors alleged Rocha and nine other current and former officials conspired with a faction of the Sinaloa Cartel known as Los Chapitos, helping it traffic drugs into the United States in exchange for political support and bribes. Rocha has repeatedly denied the allegations. He stepped aside temporarily in early May as Mexican authorities reviewed the case, and said on Friday he was returning with his "head held high."

item.title: Tesla e outras empresas iniciam recall recorde de veículos na China
item.description: A Tesla e outras oito montadoras anunciaram nesta sexta-feira que farão um recall de um total de cerca de 4,3 milhões de veículos na China devido a preocupações de que as portas possam ser difíceis de abrir em caso de emergência, o que representa o maior recall automotivo do país.
item.dc:creator: Qiaoyi Li, Ju-min Park
item.content:encoded: A Tesla e outras oito montadoras anunciaram nesta sexta-feira que farão um recall de um total de cerca de 4,3 milhões de veículos na China devido a preocupações de que as portas possam ser difíceis de abrir em caso de emergência, o que representa o maior recall automotivo do país. As medidas corretivas do recall vão desde atualizações de software até etiquetas de aviso e marcações aprimoradas ao redor das maçanetas das portas. Pequim intensificou este ano a fiscalização do setor de veículos elétricos e introduziu requisitos de segurança mais rigorosos, à medida que as montadoras, envolvidas em uma acirrada guerra de preços, lançam novas tecnologias no maior mercado automotivo do mundo. A China também anunciou que proibirá maçanetas ocultas a partir de 2027, tornando-se o primeiro país a eliminar gradualmente um design popularizado pela Tesla e amplamente adotado pelos fabricantes chineses de veículos elétricos. A Tesla não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário, enquanto Geely e Xpeng se recusaram a comentar. A Xiaomi afirmou não ter informações adicionais além do aviso regulatório. A Leapmotor disse estar comprometida com a segurança. A empresa explicou que a atualização envolvia apenas um rótulo de advertência e a atualização do software de controle dos vidros elétricos, mas que estava “gerenciando e registrando o processo de acordo com o procedimento de recall por uma questão de responsabilidade para com nossos usuários”. A maioria das medidas, classificadas como recalls de produtos sob as regulamentações chinesas, visa as alças mecânicas de abertura de emergência das portas que, segundo os reguladores, podem ser difíceis de localizar ou acionar em caso de acidente — um defeito que tem sido alvo de escrutínio após vários casos de passageiros presos dentro de veículos em chamas. A mídia estatal chinesa noticiou em outubro que o motorista de um sedã Xiaomi SU7 morreu após um acidente e incêndio porque os transeuntes não conseguiram abrir as portas para retirá-lo do veículo.

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os preços da soja no mercado brasileiro registram alta "expressiva" de mais de 5% na última semana, atingindo o maior nível nominal desde abril de 2023 no Paraná, em momento de entressafra e forte procura para processamento no país e exportação, avaliou nesta sexta-feira o centro de estudos Cepea. Além disso, houve retração de vendedores, de olho em riscos climáticos do [USN:L1N44H12A TEXT:"El Niño"] para a próxima safra no Brasil e nas condições de desenvolvimento das lavouras nos Estados Unidos. "Esse cenário elevou a disputa pelo produto brasileiro", disse o Centro de Estudos Avançados em Economia Aplicada (Cepea). Os indicadores de preços Cepea/Esalq Paranaguá e Paraná subiram aos maiores patamares nominais diários desde abril de 2023, com o primeiro se aproximando de [USN:IGB7A6176 TEXT:"R$155"] a saca de 60 kg. De 13 a 20 de agosto, o indicador em Paranaguá avançou 5,2%, enquanto no Paraná subiu 4,5%. Na média das regiões acompanhadas pelo Cepea, os preços da soja subiram 3,8% no mercado de balcão (valor pago ao produtor) e 3% no mercado de lotes (negociações entre empresas). A demanda externa segue aquecida, sobretudo da China. No mercado doméstico, indústrias brasileiras vêm intensificando as aquisições para recompor e garantir os estoques, apontou o centro da Esalq/USP.

item.title: Reports: Marc Stad purchases lead stake in Wolves, Lynx
item.description: Marc Stad has completed a deal to become the controlling owner of the NBA's Minnesota Timberwolves and WNBA's Minnesota Lynx by purchasing the majority of co-owner Marc Lore's stake at a $4.5 billion valuation, multiple media outlets reported on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Marc Stad has completed a deal to become the controlling owner of the NBA's Minnesota Timberwolves and WNBA's Minnesota Lynx by purchasing the majority of co-owner Marc Lore's stake at a $4.5 billion valuation, multiple media outlets reported on Friday. Stad, the founder and managing partner of Dragoneer Investment Group, has been a minority investor in both basketball teams under the ownership group of Lore and Alex Rodriguez. The reported deal will need approval from the NBA Board of Governors, which has its next meeting on Sept. 15-16. Per reports, Stad's wife, Elisa, will serve as the Timberwolves' governor and Rodriguez will remain a co-owner of both teams. Lore, in turn, will move into a limited role in the ownership group. Per the Athletic, he is stepping away from his role as governor to focus on taking his food delivery and takeout business, the Wonder Group, public. The reported transaction comes approximately 14 months after Lore and Rodriguez assumed full control of the Timberwolves and Lynx from previous owner Glen Taylor. Lore and Rodriguez bought into the Wolves in 2021 at a $1.5 billion valuation, with an agreement to purchase the team in full from Taylor. Taylor bought the club in 1994 for $88 million. --Field Level Media

item.title: ANP avança para monitorar mistura de biodiesel por notas fiscais eletrônicas
item.description: A diretoria da Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis (ANP) aprovou nesta sexta-feira consulta e audiência públicas sobre mudanças em regras para o biodiesel que permitirão à autarquia acessar diariamente notas fiscais eletrônicas de operações com o biocombustível e o diesel, ampliando e agilizando a fiscalização do cumprimento da mistura obrigatória pelas distribuidoras.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A diretoria da Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis (ANP) aprovou nesta sexta-feira consulta e audiência públicas sobre mudanças em regras para o biodiesel que permitirão à autarquia acessar diariamente notas fiscais eletrônicas de operações com o biocombustível e o diesel, ampliando e agilizando a fiscalização do cumprimento da mistura obrigatória pelas distribuidoras. Segundo a agência, o acesso aos arquivos eletrônicos das notas fiscais de biodiesel, diesel A e diesel B permitirá acompanhar continuamente as operações do mercado e identificar com maior rapidez eventuais descumprimentos da mistura obrigatória. Atualmente, o acompanhamento do cumprimento da mistura obrigatória de biodiesel é feito, principalmente, com base em informações declaradas mensalmente pelos agentes à ANP, por meio do Sistema de Informações de Movimentação de Produtos (i-SIMP), segundo a agência. "Como esses dados são enviados no mês seguinte ao das operações, o modelo não permite que a Agência adote de forma imediata os mecanismos de controle previstos na nova legislação", disse a agência. A consulta pública ficará aberta por 45 dias. O reforço da fiscalização ocorre em meio a preocupações do governo e do setor com fraudes na mistura obrigatória de biodiesel, prática que reduz a demanda pelo biocombustível e gera concorrência desleal entre distribuidoras.

item.title: Shakhtar to play Champions League home games at Chelsea's Stamford Bridge
item.description: Shakhtar Donetsk will play their home matches in the Champions League's league phase at Chelsea's Stamford Bridge this season, both clubs announced on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Shakhtar Donetsk will play their home matches in the Champions League's league phase at Chelsea's Stamford Bridge this season, both clubs announced on Friday. The Ukrainian champions have been unable to use their Donbas Arena since Russian-backed forces entered the region in 2014 and were further displaced by Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. Since leaving Donetsk, Shakhtar have played domestic matches in Kyiv and Lviv, while hosting European fixtures in Hamburg, Warsaw, Gelsenkirchen, Krakow and Ljubljana. The move to London comes after Chelsea failed to qualify for European competition following a 10th-placed Premier League finish last season, leaving Stamford Bridge available for Shakhtar's Champions League campaign. "We are grateful to Chelsea Football Club for the opportunity to host our games at this special venue," Shakhtar said in a statement. "Stamford Bridge is one of the most famous stadiums in world football, with an incredible history and atmosphere. "We are convinced that Shakhtar's matches in London will provide unforgettable emotions for Ukrainian and English fans." Chelsea were formerly owned by Russian oligarch [USN:L8N3XN11K TEXT:"Roman Abramovich"], who was sanctioned by the UK government following Moscow's invasion of Ukraine in 2022, triggering the sale of the club to a group led by American investor Todd Boehly and Clearlake Capital. Stamford Bridge has a capacity of around 40,000. "Shakhtar have played in countries across Europe and we look forward to welcoming them to London for their Champions League campaign this year," Chelsea said. "We will be working closely with the Shakhtar team over the coming weeks to ensure that matchdays run safely and smoothly for their team and supporters."

item.title: Turkey to seek Interpol notice for Netanyahu in Gaza flotilla case
item.description: Turkey said on Friday it would seek an Interpol red notice for the arrest of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu as part of a domestic criminal case linked to an attack on activists seeking to deliver humanitarian aid to Gaza.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Turkey said on Friday it would seek an Interpol red notice for the arrest of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu as part of a domestic criminal case linked to an attack on activists seeking to deliver humanitarian aid to Gaza. NATO member Turkey has been one of the fiercest critics of Israel's assault on Gaza and has previously issued domestic arrest warrants for Netanyahu over the war there. It has repeatedly called for international measures against Israel over what Ankara calls its violations of human rights and international law. Israel denies those charges. [USN:L6N41W0YA TEXT:"In May,"] Israeli forces opened fire on at least two vessels from the Global Sumud Flotilla sailing towards Gaza as it was making a renewed attempt to deliver aid to the enclave after earlier missions were [USN:L1N41E0DW TEXT:"intercepted by Israel"] in international waters. In a post on X, Turkish Justice Minister Akin Gurlek said arrest warrants had been issued for Netanyahu and another suspect on charges that included genocide, crimes against humanity and torture as part of a case against 35 people over the Israeli interception in international waters. "In line with the arrest warrants issued against Benjamin Netanyahu ... our justice ministry has requested that the interior ministry issue (Interpol) red notices for them so that they may be sought internationally," Gurlek said. Turkey will use all available legal mechanisms to ensure Israel is held accountable for its crimes in Gaza, he added. A red notice is a request to police forces worldwide to locate and provisionally arrest a person pending extradition. Interpol reviews requests submitted by member states before deciding whether to issue red notices. ISRAEL BRANDS MOVE 'PATHETIC' Asked about Gurlek's statement, Netanyahu's office said: "(Turkish President Tayyip) Erdogan's pathetic attempt to intimidate the leaders and soldiers of Israel, the only true democracy in the Middle East, will go nowhere." Turkey and Israel also [USN:L1N44H05K TEXT:"traded barbs"] this week over Syria, where Israel carried out [USN:L6N44F0E4 TEXT:"airstrikes"] on an air base it said Turkish troops could be deployed to, drawing condemnation from Ankara and criticism from the United States. Syria has said there were no plans to deploy Turkish troops to the base. Turkey's influence in Syria as an ally of Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa has stirred Israeli alarm since Sharaa toppled veteran leader Bashar al-Assad in 2024. Ankara has said Israeli rhetoric against Turkey and its actions in Syria are fuelled by the approach of a parliamentary election in Israel in October.

item.description: El gobernador del estado mexicano Sinaloa, Rubén Rocha, quien había solicitado licencia tras ser señalado por Estados Unidos de vínculos con el narcotráfico, anunció el viernes que retomó su cargo.

item.content:encoded: El gobernador del estado mexicano Sinaloa, Rubén Rocha, quien había solicitado licencia tras ser señalado por Estados Unidos de vínculos con el narcotráfico, anunció el viernes que retomó su cargo. Rocha, de 77 años y miembro del partido gobernante Morena, se [USN:L6N41F05Q TEXT:"apartó temporalmente"] de su cargo a principios de mayo para enfrentar acusaciones presentadas en abril por funcionarios estadounidenses sobre sus vínculos con el narcotráfico, lo que él ha negado rotundamente. A finales de abril, el Departamento de Justicia de Estados Unidos[USN:L6N41C18T TEXT:" hizo pública"] una acusación formal contra Rocha y otros nueve funcionarios y exfuncionarios sinaloenses por narcotráfico y delitos relacionados con armas. Los fiscales estadounidenses alegaron que mantenían una alianza con una facción del Cártel de Sinaloa conocida como los "Chapitos", liderada por los hijos del cofundador del cártel, Joaquín "El Chapo" Guzmán.

item.title: Ataque russo a shopping center na Ucrânia deixa 6 mortos e cerca de 90 feridos
item.description: Pelo menos seis pessoas morreram e cerca de 90 ficaram feridas nesta sexta-feira, quando drones russos atacaram um shopping center na cidade de Kryvyi Rih, no centro da Ucrânia, segundo as autoridades locais.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Pelo menos seis pessoas morreram e cerca de 90 ficaram feridas nesta sexta-feira, quando drones russos atacaram um shopping center na cidade de Kryvyi Rih, no centro da Ucrânia, segundo as autoridades locais. Seis crianças estavam entre os feridos no ataque ocorrido durante o dia na cidade natal do presidente Volodymyr Zelenskiy, informou o governador regional Oleksandr Hanzha pelo aplicativo de mensagens Telegram. “Vinte e uma pessoas estão em estado grave, incluindo uma criança”, disse. Ele postou uma foto de fumaça preta subindo de um grande prédio industrial. Zelenskiy classificou o ataque como “absolutamente cínico e desprezível”, afirmando que um segundo drone russo atingiu o shopping center meia hora após o primeiro, em uma tentativa deliberada de atingir os serviços de emergência. “Ataques como esses são nada menos do que atos terroristas”, disse Zelenskiy no Telegram, instando o mundo a responsabilizar a Rússia. A Rússia está intensificando sua guerra aérea contra a Ucrânia, à medida que os combates no campo de batalha se aproximam da marca de quatro anos e meio. Na quinta-feira, 17 pessoas morreram em um ataque com mísseis balísticos russos à capital ucraniana, Kiev. A Ucrânia também intensificou seus próprios ataques contra a Rússia, visando instalações petrolíferas e infraestrutura logística para tentar minar a capacidade de Moscou de conduzir a guerra.

item.title: Ataque ruso contra un centro comercial en Ucrania deja seis muertos y unos 90 heridos
item.description: Al menos seis personas murieron y unas 90 resultaron heridas el viernes cuando varios drones rusos atacaron un centro comercial en la ciudad de Krivói Rog, en el centro de Ucrania, según informaron las autoridades locales.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Al menos seis personas murieron y unas 90 resultaron heridas el viernes cuando varios drones rusos atacaron un centro comercial en la ciudad de Krivói Rog, en el centro de Ucrania, según informaron las autoridades locales. item.title: Petrobras enters negotiations for four offshore blocks in Ghana's Keta Basin
item.description: Brazil's state-run oil company, Petrobras , said on Friday it had submitted an expression of interest for exploration blocks in Ghana and begun negotiations.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Brazil's state-run oil company, Petrobras (PETR3.SA) , said on Friday it had submitted an expression of interest for exploration blocks in Ghana and begun negotiations. The West African nation's Ministry of Energy and Green Transition had approved its application to negotiate exploration contracts for four offshore blocks in the Keta Basin, Petrobras said. Sylvia Anjos, Petrobras' head of exploration and production, told Reuters that the Ghana blocks are geologically similar to Brazil's Equatorial Margin, which is considered the country's most promising oil frontier. The oil major plans to make Africa its main exploratory region outside of Brazil, Petrobras Chief Executive Magda Chambriard [USN:L2N3S8117 TEXT:"told Reuters last year"]. Beyond Ghana, Petrobras has been looking in to several African countries for opportunities, including Sao Tome and Principe, Namibia, Ivory Coast and South Africa. The move is aligned with Petrobras' strategy of replenishing oil and gas reserves through exploration in new frontier areas in Brazil and abroad, the company said in a securities filing. It added that it is evaluating opportunities to diversify its exploration portfolio and support long-term growth.

item.title: Why is Trump talking about the Keystone XL oil pipeline?
item.description: A social media post by U.S. President Donald Trump declaring that the Keystone XL oil pipeline "may be awoken from the grave" attracted attention this week in the midst of U.S.-Canada trade talks. Below is a look at the history of that project running through parts of Canada and the U.S., as well as details on the new oil pipeline proposal that follows a slightly different route:
item.dc:creator: Amanda Stephenson
item.content:encoded: A social media post by U.S. President Donald Trump declaring that the Keystone XL oil pipeline "may be awoken from the grave" attracted attention this week in the midst of U.S.-Canada trade talks. Below is a look at the history of that project running through parts of Canada and the U.S., as well as details on the new oil pipeline proposal that follows a slightly different route: WHAT IS KEYSTONE XL? Keystone XL was a proposed crude pipeline, roughly 1,900 km (1,181 miles) long, which would have carried 830,000 barrels per day of oil from the oil sands of northern Alberta to the major U.S. storage hub at Cushing, Oklahoma, and then on to Gulf Coast refineries. The project, which was opposed by many environmental and Indigenous groups, was rejected by U.S. President Barack Obama's administration and revived by Trump during his first term. Though construction work had started, the pipeline was never completed after U.S. President Joe Biden revoked a key permit for the U.S. stretch of the project in 2021. WHICH COMPANIES ARE INVOLVED? The company behind Keystone XL, Canada's TC Energy, lost billions when the pipeline was canceled. It later spun off its crude pipelines business into a new entity, South Bow, so that it could focus on natural gas instead. But Trump has been vocal about wanting to see the Keystone expansion built. Canada, the world's fourth-largest oil exporter, sends more than 90% of its crude oil production to the U.S., and many U.S. refineries are dependent on Canadian heavy oil. While South Bow previously said it had "moved on" from the Keystone project, forecasts for increased Canadian oil production led the company earlier this year to propose a new pipeline project called Prairie Connector. The 550,000-barrel-per-day project, which South Bow is working on in partnership with U.S. company [USN:L6N40P0K6 TEXT:"Bridger Pipeline, "]would run from Alberta to Wyoming and would use some of the Keystone XL pipe that had been installed on the Canadian side of the border before that project was canceled. South Bow has said it will decide whether or not to go ahead with Prairie Connector in 2027. The company's CEO has said he needs proof that a U.S. presidential permit is [USN:L6N42519C TEXT:""durable""] before proceeding. South Bow declined to comment on Trump's recent posts. WHAT ROLE DOES THE PIPELINE HAVE IN TRADE TALKS? Reuters reported Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney raised a potential revival of the project during trade talks with Trump [USN:L6N3VP0WR TEXT:" last October"], presenting it as a possible area of cooperation between the two countries. Trade talks then stalled for months. Trump posted a meme about Keystone shortly after announcing late on Tuesday night he had given Canada a three-day [USN:L6N44F0Z0 TEXT:"reprieve "]on more tariffs. He posted the meme again ahead of a new midnight deadline to reach[USN:L1N44I0GP TEXT:" a deal. "]

item.title: Edison data did not show Dominion machines deleted and switched votes in 2020 US election
item.description: Posts reviving a discredited claim that Edison Research data showed millions of deleted and switched votes in the 2020 election that made Joe Biden U.S. president have made a comeback online.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Posts reviving a discredited claim that Edison Research data showed millions of deleted and switched votes in the 2020 election that made Joe Biden U.S. president have made a comeback online. An Edison spokesperson referred Reuters to comments provided to media outlets in 2020 by company president Larry Rosin saying the firm had not produced any such report and had found no evidence of voter fraud. “All of this information is still correct,” Joe Lenski, Edison Research at SSRS executive vice president, said in an email of Rosin’s statements at the time. Posts in August nonetheless said that Edison found Dominion voting machines had deleted millions of votes and switched as many as 435,000 votes from President Donald Trump to former Vice President Joe Biden, sharing a clip from a 2020 One America News segment that made similar claims. The OAN segment attributed the information to an “unaudited analysis” of Edison Research data, which appeared in an anonymous post on the pro-Trump website TheDonald.win , citing Edison data. It was later promoted by the Gateway Pundit and subsequently amplified by OAN, Trump and some of his supporters . However, the U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency said in November 2020 that it had found "no evidence that any voting system deleted or lost votes, changed votes, or was in any way compromised." In a December 2020 statement , updated in May 2021, voting machine supplier Dominion denied allegations that its technology deleted or altered election results and said there is no evidence to suggest that there was a “systemic problem with vote-counting machines." Dominion, rebranded as Liberty Vote following a 2025 acquisition, and OAN did not respond to Reuters’ requests for comment. In 2021, Dominion [USN:FWN2PH16I TEXT:"sued OAN"], [USN:L6N3UA0IH TEXT:"Newsmax"], [USN:L6N3UA0IH TEXT:"Fox News"] and other entities that had promoted the accusations. In 2024, Dominion and OAN's parent company, Herring Networks, agreed to dismiss the lawsuit and related counterclaims. Among the allegations in the original audit was that Pennsylvania’s voting systems had lost or deleted nearly a million votes and switched a quarter million votes from one candidate to another. Pennsylvania's Department of State spokesperson Matt Heckel told Reuters in an email that the state's November 2020 election was "free, fair, and secure, with no widespread voter fraud," adding that Pennsylvania counties conduct two separate audits after every election before results are certified. A Reuters investigation this year found that Trump administration officials and investigators have re-examined voter-fraud cases that courts and bipartisan reviews have rejected and, based on discredited narratives about Dominion voting machines, continue to try to [USN:L6N41Y16I TEXT:"invalidate"] voting machines before the midterms. Verdict False. Edison did not produce any analysis or report linking Dominion voting machines to switched or deleted votes during the 2020 election. item.title: Buyout firm Vista explores $3 billion sale of private markets data provider Allvue, sources say
item.description: Vista Equity Partners is weighing a potential sale of Allvue Systems, in a deal that could value the provider of data and analytics for asset managers and credit investors at as much as $3 billion including debt, four people familiar with the matter said.
item.dc:creator: Amy-Jo Crowley, David French, Milana Vinn
item.content:encoded: Vista Equity Partners is weighing a potential sale of Allvue Systems, in a deal that could value the provider of data and analytics for asset managers and credit investors at as much as $3 billion including debt, four people familiar with the matter said. The move comes almost five years since Allvue's efforts to list via an initial public offering on the New York Stock Exchange were thwarted by the end of a bull run in financial technology stocks in the fall of 2021. While many companies have struggled with subdued investor interest and depressed valuations in the years since, 2026 has seen a recovery in deal-making efforts involving specialized financial technology and data providers which have businesses resilient to the growth of artificial intelligence. Against this more positive backdrop, Vista has engaged bankers at Evercore (EVR.N) and Barclays (BARC.L) to explore sale options for the Miami-headquartered Allvue, whose products help manage investments, track performance and streamline back-office operations. Discussions with potential buyers are at an early stage, said the sources who cautioned that no deal was guaranteed and spoke on condition of anonymity to discuss confidential information. Vista and Barclays declined comment. Allvue and Evercore did not respond to comment requests. Vista formed Allvue Systems in 2019 by acquiring AltaReturn and merging it with its existing portfolio company, Black Mountain Systems. The company has since expanded through acquisitions, including private markets software firm PFA Solutions in 2024. Allvue now generates more than $200 million in annual recurring revenue, one of the people said. Allvue could fetch somewhere between $2 billion and $3 billion in the event of a sale, said the person and a further source, based on the firm’s annual growth rate of more than 15%, margins exceeding 30%, and valuations achieved by comparable companies in the sectors. By comparison, when Vista pulled Allvue's IPO in September 2021, it was seeking a valuation of around $1.7 billion. As well as broader sector tailwinds, Allvue should benefit from perceived scarcity value, given few of its peers are not already inside large financial institutions. For example, BlackRock (BLK.N) completed its £2.55 billion ($3.5 billion) acquisition of Preqin in March 2025.
